unavailableBody: TabMerger couldn't reach the server to check this account's encryption, so sync is paused. Your groups are still saved on this device. Check your connection and try again.
unlockBody: Enter your encryption passphrase to unlock synced data on this device. This is a one-time step per device — you won't be asked again unless you sign out. There is no way to recover your data if you forget it — it never leaves your device and TabMerger cannot reset it for you.
setupBody: Your synced group and tab data is end-to-end encrypted with a passphrase only you know. Choose one now — there is no way to recover your data if you forget it, it never leaves your device and TabMerger cannot reset it for you.

error.tooShort: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters
error.wasReset: Encryption was reset for this account. Choose a new passphrase.
